retrieval_note: The raw market files (VIX.csv, VIX3M.csv, TSM.json, SOXX.json, QQQ.json, SPY.json, USDTWD.json) are downloaded market data and are not in the repository. They exist only on the machine that built this snapshot; no durable copy has been arranged. Their source URLs serve changing histories, so exact replay requires the saved bytes matching the hashes below, and a fresh download must be pinned as a new snapshot.

USDTWD.json.note: New Taiwan dollars per US dollar, daily. 447 of 5914 rows have no close. Not an official fixing.

tsmc_monthly_revenue_events.json.source: SEC EDGAR full-text search and submissions index for CIK 0001046179; see describe in the file

us_equity_sessions_2002_2026.json.source: Generated by rule and cross-checked; see basis_note in the file

tsmc_monthly_revenue_figures.json.source: https://investor.tsmc.com/english/monthly-revenue/<year>, one page per year; see describe in the file

treasury_real_yield_10y.csv.source: https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/daily-treasury-rates.csv/<year>/all?type=daily_treasury_real_yield_curve, one file per year, 10 YR column

us_treasury_yield_sessions_2003_2026.jso.source: Generated by rule and checked against the dates in treasury_real_yield_10y.csv; see basis_note in the file

tsmc_monthly_revenue_first_release.json.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/<id>, one press release per month; see describe in the file

announcement_dates_2002_2026.json.source: ALFRED release dates and BLS schedules (CPI, PPI), federalreserve.gov (FOMC), investor.tsmc.com (TSMC earnings); see describe in the file
